articles.title: Bitcoin jumps above $63,000, reversing end-June losses
articles.snippet: The token hit its highest in over a month during thin July 4 trading, with XRP up 5% in 24 hours to lead gains among majors.

articles.title: UK's bold new crypto rules promise to unlock global trading, but huge compliance hurdles still threaten the rollout
articles.snippet: The U.K. FCA's crypto framework has been praised for prioritizing global liquidity and institutional adoption, but the authorization process is expected to be daunting.

articles.title: This sanctioned Russian stablecoin claims it processes billions, but blockchain analysts disagree
articles.snippet: A7A5 claims crypto data providers understate its trading activity, while blockchain analytics firms say the ruble-backed token's volumes have fallen sharply this year.

articles.title: Kalshi hits record June trading volume as World Cup fuels prediction markets
articles.snippet: DefiLlama data shows Kalshi posted a record month for trading volume as the expanded FIFA World Cup boosted prediction market activity.

articles.title: Zcash’s Ironwood upgrade faces possible delay over infrastructure readiness
articles.snippet: Shielded Labs said exchanges, mining pools and wallets may need more time to complete Zcash’s Z3 software migration and safely prepare for Ironwood.
